subject: Production latency spike — remedy & trial extension request (Helios Analytics)
messages:
From: Elena Ortiz <elena@heliosanalytics.com>
To: ava.chen@redwood.ai
Cc: support@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-07-29T08:55:00-07:00
Subject: Production latency spike — urgent compensation request

Hi Ava,

We had a sustained latency spike across our production fleet between 06:40–07:20 PDT this morning. The impact: several synchronous API calls to your hosted endpoints timed out for approximately 25 minutes, and we saw an overall 3x increase in tail latency during the window. This affected several checkout flows for our merchant customers and triggered major PagerDuty noise.

We need: (1) a formal incident summary and root cause once available, and (2) a proposal for remediation credits and an extension of our trial credit window while we stabilize. We were mid-proof-of-concept and the disruption has materially impacted our ability to complete the integration tests this week.

Attaching our internal incident notes for context. Happy to hop on a call.

Thanks,
Elena Ortiz
Head of Platform Reliability
Helios Analytics
[Attachment: helios_internal_incident_notes.txt]
From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ortiz <elena@heliosanalytics.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai, markus.klein@redwood.ai, support@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-07-29T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Production latency spike — urgent compensation request

Hi Elena — thanks for the heads up and I’m sorry Helios hit this. I’ve looped in Ben (sales lead), Marissa (CS), Markus (ops lead) and our SRE/support team so we can triage and put a proposal on the table today.

Next steps on our side:
- Support will share an incident timeline and preliminary RCA by EOD.
- Finance/Sales will prepare a credit proposal + a short-term trial extension for any lost runway.
- I’ll schedule a 30-min sync this afternoon to align on the customer-facing note.

I’ve attached Helios’s incident notes and will share our internal credit calc when ready.

Talk soon —

Ava Chen
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ava.chen@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0124
[Attachment: helios_internal_incident_notes.txt]
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-07-29T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Helios latency — quick credit proposal check

Ava/Marissa — reading Elena’s note. SRE is already on the RCA. From a commercial perspective I’m comfortable with a goodwill package equal to 20% of Helios’s July committed usage plus a 30-day extension of their trial credits (we need to preserve the ability to upsell once they’re stable). Markus, any objections on the signal?

Markus: if SRE confirms outage window of ~40 mins with timeouts, we should greenlight this and have Finance prepare the DocuSign addendum.

Ben

On Thu, Jul 29, 2027 at 9:12 AM Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Hi Elena — thanks for the heads up and I’m sorry Helios hit this....
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-07-29T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Helios latency — quick credit proposal check

Ben — SRE confirms: degraded tail latency from 06:38–07:20 PDT; several upstream dependencies overloaded during a spike in traffic routing that affected request fanout. Root cause not yet finalized but the observed impact matches the customer timeline. 20% credit of July usage sounds reasonable as a starting point. Please include a 10k token top-up (trial sweetener) in the proposal to help Helios finish the integration tests — it’s cheap for us and high value for them.

Markus

On Thu, Jul 29, 2027 at 10:03 AM Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Ava/Marissa — reading Elena’s note. SRE is already on the RCA...
From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ortiz <elena@heliosanalytics.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai, markus.klein@redwood.ai, support@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-07-29T13:25:00-07:00
Subject: Helios — proposed remedy package and next steps

Hi Elena — following up with an initial remedy package while SRE finishes the full postmortem. Key points below and attached: credit calculation and a short DocuSign addendum ready for signature.

What we’re proposing (initial):
- Service credit: 20% of Helios’s billed usage for July 2027, applied as platform credit to your account.
- Trial top-up: 10,000 token credit to help complete integration testing (one-time).
- Trial extension: 30-day extension of your existing trial credit window, effective from signature date.
- Deliverables: final incident postmortem (PDF) + timeline by EOD tomorrow.

Attachments: credit_calc_helios.xlsx (breakdown), preliminary incident timeline (will update).

If that package works for you I’ll kick off the DocuSign workflow and have Finance issue the credit. Otherwise tell me which parts you want adjusted and we’ll iterate quickly.

Best,

Ava Chen
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ava.chen@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0124
[Attachment: credit_calc_helios.xlsx]
From: Elena Ortiz <elena@heliosanalytics.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>
Cc: ops@heliosanalytics.com
Date: 2027-07-29T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Helios — proposed remedy package and next steps

Ava — thanks for the quick turnaround. The proposed package looks fair. Two small asks before we sign: (1) can you add a short clause to the DocuSign that clarifies the credit cannot be redeemed for cash (standard for our procurement team), and (2) can the trial extension start from the date the RCA is delivered rather than signature date? Procurement prefers deferring extension until we have the RCA.

Once that’s in the paperwork I’ll route to Procurement and Legal for a fast-sign. Please also include the SRE postmortem when it’s ready — procurement will want to keep that on file.

Appreciate the responsiveness.

—Elena
From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ortiz <elena@heliosanalytics.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai, markus.klein@redwood.ai, finance@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-07-30T09:43:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Helios — proposed remedy package and next steps

Hi Elena — thanks, and that makes sense. We’ll update the DocuSign addendum with the two items you requested: (1) clause confirming credits are non-cash redeemable; (2) trial extension effective from delivery of the RCA. Finance and Legal have reviewed and the updated addendum is routed via DocuSign here: https://na3.docusign.net/envelope/ABCD1234

I’ve also attached the preliminary postmortem; final will follow EOD. Once you sign the addendum we’ll queue the credits and token top-up.

Next calls: I’ll book a 15-min handoff with your procurement to smooth the signing if helpful.

Thanks again for working with us on this — we want to get Helios back on track quickly.

Best,

Ava Chen
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ava.chen@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0124
